candidates.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent portrait 2:3 full-body game sprite. Primary request: Create one authentic SOUTH-facing/front view of the Portolume gym leader Nerea as a complete character sprite. Input images: Image 1 is the only identity/outfit reference: use ONLY the top-left Nerea figure, frame 0, from the Veloria Gym Leaders B atlas. Images 2-5 (Elia, Nilo, Mira, Dalia) are painterly modern 2D Veloria RPG style references only; do not copy their subjects, faces, clothing, accessories or poses. Subject: Preserve Nerea's apparent face identity and the exact recognizable frame-0 design: long dark chestnut curly hair gathered partly back with a teal ribbon and a small muted coral ribbon detail; short practical harbor coat in deep teal with pale sand/cream panels and the atlas's restrained wave details; dark simple inner top; wide light trousers cropped above the ankle; teal harbor boots with muted coral laces/accents; brown belt, worn cross-body strap, and the same small hanging brass tide instrument/accessory attached to the worn strap/belt. Keep the shoulder bag worn at the anatomical LEFT hip (viewer-right in front), and its strap crossing from the anatomical LEFT shoulder; it is worn, not held. Do not design or consolidate the identity with the separate Nerea of the League Council. Composition: One centered entire figure from hair to both soles, natural proportions, ample transparent margin. Pose: relaxed neutral standing idle; both arms hang naturally outside the coat, both hands visible, empty and relaxed; remove the atlas's hand-in-pocket and hand-holding-the-strap pose, while retaining the naturally worn bag and strap. True transparent alpha, no floor, background, shadow, glow, halo or vignette. Style: polished warm painterly modern 2D RPG illustration consistent with the style-only references. Constraints: no invented gender or age, no extra accessories or props, no held notebook/whistle/tools, no new jewelry, no extra bags, no duplicated strap, no flipped/mirrored outfit, no text, no cropping, no extra figure, no 3D or photorealism.

calibration.originX: alpha-weighted centroid of alpha>=128 pixels in the bottom 50px of the visible body bounding box, normalized by image width
calibration.originY: exclusive bottom of visible alpha>=128 body bounding box, normalized by image height
calibration.note: Source PNGs are preserved raw; runtime WebP files decode to pixel-identical RGBA. The north interaction tile is blocked by existing geometry and is documented in the E2E/offline fixture rather than changed.
